channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Jantar Mantar row explained: Journalist alleges sexual assault by Delhi cop, protesters demand FIR
item.description: An independent journalist has alleged that a senior Delhi Police officer groped and pushed her while she was covering a protest at Jantar Mantar. Journalists, protesters and lawyers have since gathered outside Parliament Street Police Station, demanding action.

item.title: 8.5 lakh books, 135 years of history: Supreme Court to hear case on relocation of Central Secretariat Library on Monday
item.description: Concerns have reportedly been raised about the availability of suitable accommodation for the 135-year-old library and the preservation of its extensive collection.

item.title: What we know about mystery pilots who saved Dubai-Tel Aviv Flydubai flight from crashing after Indian pilot attacked
item.description: Three days after an Omani co-pilot allegedly attacked Indian pilot Smit Machchhar with a crash axe on a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, attention has turned to two mystery pilots who rushed into the cockpit and helped prevent the plane from crashing.

item.title: OpenClaw creator turns to X after app review delay; Sundar Pichai says ‘will follow up’. Internet reacts
item.description: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger turned to X after the Android app remained in review for more than a week. Google CEO Sundar Pichai replied directly, and Steinberger later said the new update was live.

item.title: Cornell University president vows 'rigorous' probe in gangrape case, shares new video: 'My heart aches'
item.description: Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff said his school's administration “must do better” amid the criticism and fallout of its investigation into the alleged gangrape.

item.title: 'Hero for the world': Netanyahu invites PM Modi, Flydubai pilot Machchhar to light celebratory flame on Independence Day
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu invited Indian pilot Smit Machchhar and PM Narendra Modi to light a flame on Israel's Independence Day after Machchhar thwarted an alleged terrorist attack on a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight.

item.title: Flydubai co-pilot who attacked Smit Machchhar to carry out a terrorist attack studied at a UK university: Report
item.description: The Flydubai co-pilot who allegedly tried to hijack a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight and carry out a terrorist attack studied at a UK university. Omani national Hamam al Hammami reportedly attacked the captain before being overpowered. Investigations are underway into his motive and possible extremist links.

item.title: More trouble for Gyanesh Kumar? Keralam orders probe in 2006 case linked to Malaysian man's suicide: What we know so far
item.description: The move comes against the backdrop of protests by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), the INDIA bloc, and student leaders against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

item.title: The week ahead in numbers: RBI policy, TCS Q2 results, Nobel prizes
item.description: RBI’s rate decision, TCS’s Q2 results, US trade data and Nobel Prize announcements headline a week packed with key economic and business data.

item.title: Iran war news LIVE updates: Trump reiterates Iran has been 'decimated,' says Washington to decide Iran war outcome
item.description: Iran war news LIVE updates: Iran-backed Yemen's Houthis claimed responsibility for an attack on an oil facility near the Saudi capital on Saturday and accused the Kingdom of striking the Yemeni capital several times

item.title: Christa Pike's botched execution: Tennessee prison chief Frank Strada resigns, says ‘I continue to believe that...’
item.description: Pike, now 50, was 18 when she and her boyfriend tortured and killed a classmate, Colleen Slemmer, in a jealous rage in 1995. She became one of the youngest women to be sent to death row.

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle turn heads with a sweet and cosy date night at a Cotswolds pub
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have been photographed together at a Cotswolds pub, marking their first joint public outing since returning to the UK with their children and settling into life in Britain.

item.title: Trump's latest announcement: $90 Medicare payments for 20 mn seniors ahead of midterm polls; eligibility, exclusions
item.description: Donald Trump has announced a one-time Medicare rebate for eligible seniors, with the administration saying it will help offset Part B costs. The payment comes as the US approaches midterm elections and excludes several groups from receiving it.

item.title: Maduro Not Immune to Prosecution in Narco-Terror Case, US Says
item.description: Nicolás Maduro is not entitled to immunity from criminal charges, US prosecutors said, countering the former Venezuelan president’s bid to toss the US’s narco-terrorism case against him.

item.title: ‘Co-pilot got up to pray, then.’: Indian pilot Machchhar reveals new details of flydubai cockpit attack to Netanyahu
item.description: The latest account provides a closer look at the critical moments inside the cockpit — from the co-pilot's request to pray to the sudden attack.

item.title: Planning a Disneyland Paris trip? Here’s what you need to know before you go during Halloween season
item.description: Disneyland Paris has faced renewed capacity restrictions as demand rises during the Halloween season, with guests without the required tickets or reservations unable to enter when both parks reach their limit.&nbsp;

item.title: Who was Mad Sandhu? Popular LGBTQ influencer, makeup artist shot dead in Amritsar; found lying on road, blood-soaked
item.description: Sandhu's public discussions about makeup, gender issues and his personal style had made him a recognisable personality among Punjabi digital audiences.

item.title: Texas hasn't elected a Democrat to US Senate since 1988: Two polls show Republican candidate trailing in midterms
item.description: Democrat James Talarico leads Republican Ken Paxton in two recent Texas Senate polls. The race is drawing attention as Texas has not elected a Democrat to the US Senate since 1988, with Paxton facing GOP divisions, weak personal ratings and economic concerns.

item.title: India-Pakistan face-off over Punjab border deaths: Delhi alleges infiltration, Islamabad calls victims civilians
item.description: India summoned the Chargé d’Affaires of the Pakistan High Commission to lodge a strong protest over what it described as continued facilitation of illegal cross-border infiltration from Pakistan.

item.title: ‘Pashu seva bhi prabhu seva hai’: Reliance Executive Director Anant Ambani’s farmers-first message from Andhra Pradesh
item.description: Anant Ambani has called for greater use of technology, skills and entrepreneurship in farming as he addressed farmers in Andhra Pradesh, where Reliance is partnering on a new agriculture school.

item.title: ‘Next year could be bad’: Zerodha co-founder Nikhil Kamath endorses grave warning for startup funding
item.description: An X user predicts a challenging startup landscape in 2027, suggesting companies raise capital soon. Nikhil Kamath endorsed this prediction.

item.title: Airlines reject 33% cut in international slots at Mumbai airport T2 from Oct 25: Report
item.description: Airlines have rejected Mumbai airport's proposed 33% cut in international departure slots from October 25. MIAL plans to temporarily discontinue 265 of 770 weekly slots at T2 for T1 redevelopment, prompting carriers to seek government intervention.

item.title: Will movie tickets in Mumbai become 7 times costlier after BMC’s tax demands? Explained
item.description: Mumbai may see higher film ticket prices due to a proposed increase in the entertainment tax from ₹60 to ₹400 per show. Exhibitors anticipate passing this burden to customers, potentially resulting in a per-ticket increase.

item.title: ‘Proud he is part of our nation's story’: Dubai Crown Prince praises Indian flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar's courage
item.description: UAE Deputy Prime Minister Hamdan visited Smit Machchhar at the hospital on Saturday (October 3) and said the pilot had demonstrated the “highest levels of courage, responsibility, and care for people's lives”.

item.title: New GRAP Rules in Delhi; restrictions in NCR October 2026: Is your car allowed? Check eligibility here from govt PDF
item.description: Delhi-NCR's revised GRAP rules tighten vehicle curbs as pollution rises. BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel cars face Stage III restrictions in Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Faridabad and Sonipat, while PUC norms remain strictly enforced.

item.title: Archana Puran Singh will ‘buy the entire Madh Island’: Social media reacts as Bollywood actress bags another property
item.description: Archana Puran Singh's family purchased a new bungalow in Madh Island, Mumbai, near their main home. Their latest vlog showcased the property.

item.title: HP laid off a 60-year-old- What she did next has internet's attention - Here's why her Antartica job is going viral
item.description: After losing her HP job in 2025, May Lee moved into seasonal work at Antarctica’s McMurdo Station, where strict hours, cargo duties, limited internet and 24-hour daylight shape her unusual daily life.

item.title: Tamil Nadu: CM Vijay announces ₹30 lakh each for India's Asian Games 2026 heroes; check who will receive the reward
item.description: India achieved historic success at the Asian Games, winning its first double gold in hockey and securing Olympic spots. Tamil Nadu CM Vijay has announced ₹30 lakh each for a number of players. Check their names.&nbsp;

item.title: George Soros family’s $102 million Democratic funding push ahead of 2026 US midterms - Details here
item.description: The 2026 congressional elections are the first midterm cycle since George Soros transferred control of his political operation to his son Alex Soros in 2023.

item.title: CJP’s Shivaji Park protest triggers FIR: Mumbai Police name organisers, 400-500 others
item.description: Mumbai Police file an FIR against CJP leaders and 400-500 others over the October 2 Shivaji Park protest.

item.title: 'A hero of our times': Mankind Pharma to give ₹1 crore to FlyDubai Capt Smit Machchhar
item.description: Mankind Pharma has announced a ₹1 crore contribution to Capt Smit Machchhar and his family, praising his courage and leadership during a crisis. Vice Chairman Rajeev Juneja said the gesture was the company's way of backing its gratitude with meaningful action.

item.title: FSSAI prohibits sale of 'unsafe, substandard' Nestle Low Fat Dairy Whitener, company responds
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has ordered immediate sale ban on Nestle Low Fat Dairy Whitener. A sample of the product collected from a New Delhi hotel was found to be ‘unsafe, substandard’ in a laboratory analysis.

item.title: RBI governor warns against complacency amid external headwinds
item.description: Governor Malhotra flagged global debt, AI valuations, leverage and cyber risk as potential threats to financial stability

item.title: 140 Indians discharged from Russian army: Govt seeks Moscow update on 55, 'balanced' trade push
item.description: India and Russia discussed bilateral ties, Indian workers and the Ukraine conflict. Around 140 Indians have been discharged from the Russian army, while India is seeking information on 55 others. Putin also praised PM Modi's efforts to promote dialogue.

item.title: $20,000 US visa bond rule: Should Indians be worried? Check the complete list of affected countries
item.description: The new US visa bond rule requires certain foreign nationals to pay a bond ranging from $10,000 to $20,000. Affected applicants must comply with payment instructions, and breaking visa conditions can lead to reviews by US immigration authorities.
